name: lfp
description: LazyCodex extension plugin for Codex model/provider configuration and category routing guidance.
author: islee23520

interface.shortDescription: Model/provider setup, three-field agent overrides, category and fallback guidance for Codex.
interface.longDescription: LFP keeps LazyCodex/OMO as the owner of agent behavior. It installs this flavour pack into Codex, optionally configures an OpenAI-compatible provider after consent, saves routing choices to lfp.json, applies only the three primary model fields to existing agent TOMLs, and provides category/fallback guidance plus interactive setup with atomic runtime promotion and rollback. LFP does not ship LFP-owned agent TOMLs.
defaultPrompt: Use LFP to configure LazyCodex/OMO model routing and provider defaults.
Use the fallback guidance when a configured agent hits quota, rate-limit, or provider failure.
Keep agent behavior sourced from LazyCodex/OMO; LFP only manages supported model fields and plugin install.
